title: SdrProposeResult
description: What a proposed design change came to: committed as a new version, or rejected with the reasons and the checks behind them (ADR-0030). Every field is set by the harness.

base_version.description: The version the change was based on.

new_version.description: Set when the outcome is committed.

reasons.description: Why the change was rejected: validation problems or gate reasons. Empty when it committed.

checks.description: The findings of the checks that ran on the change, in the order they ran. Empty when the change was invalid, since no check ran.

SdrProposeCheck.description: One check finding, as stored in the evidence store.
